ex.en: The Shanghainese people must build up Shanghai's new image.
ex.zh: 上海人必須建立上海的新形象。

ex.en: The company is trying to improve its image.
ex.zh: 這家公司正努力改善形象。

ex.en: Images and videos are transformed into gifs and memes.
ex.zh: 影像和影片被轉換為GIF和哏。

ex.en: Choose a suitable satellite image as the base map.
ex.zh: 選擇合適的衛星圖做為底圖。

ex.en: Please let me see your passport, also did you complete the immigration form?
ex.zh: 請出示護照。入境表格填好了嗎？

ex.en: The line at immigration was very long.
ex.zh: 入境審查的隊伍排得很長。

ex.en: The government is changing its immigration policy.
ex.zh: 政府正在修改移民政策。

ex.en: Immigration has changed the city over the past 50 years.
ex.zh: 過去五十年來，移民改變了這座城市。

ex.en: Lots of companies have implemented an eight-hour working day.
ex.zh: 很多公司實施每天八小時工作制。

ex.en: Our company will implement new price standards regarding this product.
ex.zh: 針對這項產品，本公司將實施新的價格標準。

ex.en: The company is starting to implement the new management system from next month.
ex.zh: 公司下個月開始推行新的管理制度。
